_doc: Model registry for scripts/run_benchmark.py. kinds: gliner (a GLiNER2 checkpoint folder under models/; vocab picks the label-name file in configs/labels/benchmark/), hf_token (a Hugging Face BIO token-classification model, mapped to taxonomy ids via kvkkbench.labels.MAPPINGS[mapping]). Adding a model = one entry; a new kind = one adapter in scripts/kvkkbench/ returning [{start, end, label, native_label, confidence}].
